evidence_type: Digitized raster curve mean estimates, not original training metrics

method.uncertainty_note: Vertical estimates are conservative raster reading tolerances, not statistical confidence intervals. On steep initial segments, horizontal displacement can dominate; initial slots are descriptive and excluded from final curve matching gates.
method.x_uncertainty: Dashed gaps can displace a sampled point by up to 3 plotted slots; exact displacement retained per point.
method.mapping_status: Candidate source recipe, not an original run metadata record
method.plotted_epoch_label: zero-based evaluation slot, not full pass over training set

acceptance_contract.status: predeclared recommendation; integrate into parent Study PLAN before judging training results
acceptance_contract.rule: All gates must pass per dataset/model for close image reproduction. Single seed full-length results are provisional diagnostics. Do not widen thresholds to match observed new results.
